devil_advocate: foreign net buy may be ETF passive creation or futures-hedge leg, not conviction: mandatory spot-futures consistency lane
institutional numbers are NET; internal wash volume invisible: gross + day-trade lanes required before intraday claims
TDCC weekly + delayed release: never use as intraday signal; ASOF release_ts enforced at schema level
attribution IC = explanatory dominance, NOT causality; reverse causality (price -> margin chase) expected; lagged design mitigates, does not eliminate
regime score weights are hand-set v0 constants: tracked as tech debt, must be re-fit by CPCV in Phase 3
M1B/M2 golden cross is MONTHLY with ~25d publication lag: as daily signal it is stale by construction; ASOF release_ts mandatory, never interpolate to daily
Fed net liquidity correlation with equities is regime-dependent folk-metric; treat as conditioning variable, not signal
FOMO composite components (margin, day-trade, retail holders) overlap with chipwar score inputs: document shared inputs to avoid double-counting one phenomenon as two confirmations
crude/DXY affect TW via terms-of-trade AND risk sentiment: sign is not stable across regimes; only lagged rank-IC decides, not narrative
limited-choices narrative vs measurement: opportunity_width must count RISK-ADJUSTED positive momentum, else a broad low-vol trad drift falsely widens the set
tech/trad bloc line is curation (T2): 重電 in trad would flip the spread sign in AI-capex regimes; hybrid bloc isolated on purpose
crowding_index correlating with chipwar_score may be mechanical (shared flow inputs): report shared-input overlap alongside the correlation
chatroom data is T2 at best: self-selected, bot-inflated, sarcasm(反串)-contaminated; sentiment classifiers trained on formal zh fail on PTT slang — lexicon must be PTT-native
deleted posts (自刪/版主刪) create survivorship holes: fetched_ts ASOF + periodic re-crawl diff to estimate deletion rate
social FOMO expected to LAG market: if it appears to LEAD, first suspect look-ahead in aggregation (posts after close counted same day)
mention_hhi vs flow_hhi cross-check: chatrooms talk about what already moved — high correlation is mechanical, only DIVERGENCE is informative (talk without flow = pure hype)
private LINE/Telegram rooms unobservable and plausibly where real 主力 chatter lives: public-chatroom FOMO measures RETAIL echo, never smart money
cross-market 'predictability' TW->SPX is often just the global factor plus session ordering: benchmark every factor against lagged SPX itself before claiming alpha
walk-forward optimizer IS an optimizer: selection criteria applied on train window only, and the WF-vs-insample gap must be reported every run; shrinking gap = growing overfit
multiple testing: factors x horizons x targets x criteria grid inflates false positives; report effective number of tests and demand ICIR not raw IC

FactSet weekly PDFs are immutable vintages: unlike FRED-style revisions this is inherently point-in-time, BUT report skips weeks (holidays) and occasionally publishes early — fetcher must tolerate date jitter, never interpolate missing Fridays
族群拆併風險: 矽晶圓(G026)從半導體拆出、記憶體封測(G029)從記憶體拆出=本週資金獨立性判斷(T2), 若獨立性是暫時的(漲價循環結束後重新併回)會造成twgc碼膨脹; 緩解=append-only下舊碼保留, 拆併僅新增不刪除, 以effective_from標記時效, 由M3實際流量相關性事後驗證拆分是否成立(負控制: 拆出族群與母族群流量相關性應顯著<1)
自營商買賣超必須拆分自行買賣 vs 避險: 把權證/ETF造市的對沖部位當成方向性看法, 是台股籌碼分析最常見的系統性錯誤
主動型ETF新募集建倉期(如00403A募800億)產生的機械式買盤 ≠ 經理人主動看多; 未加 is_new_launch_window 旗標會嚴重污染同步訊號
外資買賣超含ETF造市/避險/陸資/MSCI再平衡; 直接當外資觀點會在指數調整週產生假訊號
投資人行為順序(rotation_sequence)為T3結構假設, 8個節點的順序未經實證; VDF接上後須以CCF逐對驗證, 順序若與假設不符須推翻而非調參
分類軸混淆是本體論錯誤而非資料錯誤: v1.0把主動ETF(載體軸)與投信(身分軸)並列, 若未察覺會在scanner中把同一筆買盤計兩次, 使信度分數系統性高估. 四層階梯的代價是L2.4殘差項承擔全部歸因誤差; 若殘差反號即上游有誤, 此為內建自檢
政府PUT不對稱是先前S4分析的重大遺漏: 國安基金護盤集中權值股, 中小型無支撐[T2 2025/4實證]. 因此'介入使無序區37%→20%'僅適用TWII; 櫃買市場的斷頭無序化幾乎不受介入影響. 散戶持股集中中小型 → 護盤保住了指數但未保住散戶部位, 此為政府PUT效力評估的系統性高估來源
只看加權指數會被權值撐盤系統性誤導: 多數股票下跌但指數不動的情況下, 加權的'穩定'是倖存者偏誤. 監控必須雙指數並行, 且以櫃買廣度作為真實市場狀態的主要參考
櫃買歸因雜訊高於加權(成分股多而個別權重低), 需≥5日平滑; 但平滑會犧牲時效, 此為時效vs穩健的固有取捨, 不可用調參掩蓋

檢定力矛盾: 主動ETF被標為priority=HIGHEST但歷史最短(2025/5起~300日). 時序IC路徑下多重校正後最小可偵測|r|=0.255, 而金融訊號典型IC僅0.02-0.05(需~19年). **高概念價值≠可統計驗證**. 救援=橫斷面ICIR(需每日≥30檔)或事件研究(300-750事件, 可測d≥0.12), 但若兩者皆不適用, 該訊號只能以T3假設使用並明示不可驗證
月報類5指標(四大基金/投信月報/董監質押/定期定額/隱形槓桿)10年僅~120觀測, 多重校正後r_min=0.404, 結構性不可檢定 → 已降級CONTEXT_ONLY, 不得進入信度分數
35指標同時檢定時83%機率至少出現1個假顯著; 若未做FDR校正, scanner會系統性納入雜訊指標並對其產生信心 — 這種錯誤不報錯不崩潰, 只讓判斷越來越自信
族群分類的存在正當性未經檢定: 若GV7增量R²不顯著, 自訂族群僅是官方產業別的重貼標籤, 且額外承擔前視偏誤與6.3%選樣偏誤 → **比直接用官方產業別更糟**. 直覺貼近不構成保留理由
前視偏誤實例已存在: 矽晶圓/記憶體封測因2026-07觀察到獨立資金流才拆出(effective_from=2026-07-18). 任何早於此日的回測若使用該分類即為使用未來資訊; 已加CHK_pit_membership約束
族群層面板不可膨脹樣本: 29族群×n_days看似數萬觀測, 但同日跨族群高度相關, 有效自由度≈n_days. 以面板n計檢定力會系統性高估顯著性
v1.2更新引入自身缺陷: 新增4族群卻未同步建置成員(n_members=0), 而五態快照已給予這些族群狀態 → 有狀態無標的. 分類更新必須成員同步, 否則產生不可執行的訊號
